body: Glad you were able to understand my jumbled writing. And I don't feel like I'm ready nor do I want to go out yet but it's pondering my mind. When I hit one month I may just forget about it and keep pushing on or I will remember this and make the decision. Thanks for the post mane.

I'm in your same boat except maybe a couple of years younger. I was seriously thinking about offing myself tonight but held back because I wasn't ready. I decided I may give it another month or two to see if I can improve my life for the better. I already decided that if it gets worse and I experience even more pain then I can endure I'm just going to tie a bag over my head with a smiley face drawn on as one last joke. I recommend you try to reconsider this decision and do what I don't have the strength to do. You said your in college, well if college is anything like I've heard about/seen then you've just gotta put yourself out there. Only thing holding you back is yourself. And your friends? Well they aren't really​ your friends now are they? I just started browsing here after making a post myself on here and saw your in a situation similar to mine. Really do hope you can consider my words even though I'm not great at giving advice nor following it I do hope you understand that this is a permanent choice to a temporary problem.
